panels.description: execution/markout.py: for each entry fill, the signed post-fill move vs the trusted mark at 5/30/60s. POSITIVE = price moved in our favour (healthy fill); NEGATIVE = it moved against us right after we filled = we were scalped. The empirical companion to the manip gauge (predicted) — a persistently negative line is the ground truth the anti-scalp gate exists to reduce.
panels.title: Post-fill mark-out (bps) — negative = adverse selection

panels.description: TH-010, 0-1: evenly spaced resting-order ladders — grid bots living in the book.
panels.title: THALES grid ladders

panels.description: TH-011 metronome, 0-1: top-of-book requoting on a fixed clock — lazy market-maker automation.
panels.title: THALES clock-driven MM

panels.description: TH-012 clockwork, 0-1: statistically significant time-of-day flow (significance-gated).
panels.title: THALES scheduled flow

panels.description: TH-013 stop-zone, averaged: the raw score is an INSTANTANEOUS proximity to the nearest stop-cluster magnet (round-number lattice + swing extremes, 1.0 at the magnet, 0 past 0.15%), which naturally square-waves as price wanders between magnets spaced 0.3-3% apart. This panel shows the 30-minute average - the share of recent time price spent pinned to cascade territory. Sustained elevation = crowded magnet = Osler sweep risk. The model consumes the raw instantaneous value at signal time, which is exactly right for that purpose. Coarse-tick or dead assets read a flat 0: when the venue's price grid is wider than the 0.15% tolerance band (e.g. FLOW at $0.026, one tick = 38bps) every price is 'at a magnet' and proximity carries no information, so the engine suppresses it rather than pin the gauge at 1.0.
panels.title: THALES stop clusters (30m avg time-near-magnet)

panels.description: Cross-asset risk appetite: z-scored move of the moomoo equity basket (COIN, MSTR, QQQ weights 1/1/0.7). Flat 0 while the US market is closed or OpenD is unreachable.
panels.title: Equity-market risk z (basket)

panels.description: COIN nearest-expiry, near-the-money options via moomoo: volume put/call ratio z, open-interest put/call ratio z, and IV skew (put IV minus call IV, /10, clipped to ±1). Z-scores need ~60 polls (15min cadence) of history before they move.
panels.title: Options positioning (COIN: PCR z / OI-PCR z / IV skew)

panels.description: Market-data fetch latency for the engine's feed cycle, milliseconds. Yellow >= 400ms, red >= 1s.
panels.title: Feed latency

panels.description: Seconds since the runner last wrote status.json, stamped at PUSH time — keeps rising if the runner freezes, even while 'Running' still shows UP. Alert fires at >180s for 5m (no-data also alerts).
panels.title: Status age

panels.description: Engine cycles since the current runner process started. Resets on every restart — compare with Lifetime cycles.
panels.title: Session cycle

panels.description: Age of the OLDEST live Kraken mark. feed_latency_ms only moves on a SUCCESSFUL call, so a Ticker-only outage freezes prices AND that gauge; marks_age_sec keeps climbing the instant a price stops updating - the truthful stale-price signal.
panels.title: Marks age
